name: flagship-earthly-delights
description: Flagship theme earthly-delights (cmux#47278), with its type set as settings for builds before the theme-file font keys.

files.themes/earthly-delights.json:
// Earthly Delights: ultra maximal. Bosch's garden at full saturation behind see-through jade glass,
// candy pinks and limes in every terminal, every animation on, cat icons, a lime braille spinner.
// Copy it to ~/.config/cmux/themes/earthly-delights.json (yours wins over this one), edit and save:
// the running app repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "Earthly Delights",
  "description": "Bosch's garden behind jade glass; candy pink and lime, everything on, everything moving.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors: loud and saturated.
  "appearance.theme": "Cyberpunk",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#06231a",
    "foreground": "#f2ffe6",
    "cursor": "#b6f23a",
    "selection": "#1f5a3f",
    "accent": "#b6f23a",
    "0": "#0b2e22",
    "1": "#ff4f8b",
    "2": "#90c81f",
    "3": "#ffcc33",
    "4": "#49b6ff",
    "5": "#ff6fd8",
    "6": "#3ff2c8",
    "7": "#d8f5c8",
    "8": "#4f8a6c",
    "9": "#ff7aa8",
    "10": "#b6f23a",
    "11": "#ffe066",
    "12": "#7ccbff",
    "13": "#ff9ae6",
    "14": "#7affdf",
    "15": "#ffffff"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "appearance.saturation": 1.4,

  // The garden behind glass, the most of it showing.
  "appearance.background": "bosch-garden-central",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.66,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.5,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": true,

  // Outlined cards everywhere, a jade sidebar of icon lines, cat icons.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card-outlined",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#03170f",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.7,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 2,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "linesIcons",
  "sidebar.density": "expanded",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#03170f",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 0.66,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#06231a",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.78,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#06231a",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.82,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#06231a",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.35,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#06231a",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 0.35,
  "appearance.iconTheme": "neko",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "both",
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "transparent",

  // Type: Folio's Hanken Grotesk, larger chrome.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "hanken",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 14,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 14,

  // Motion: everything on, springy, a big lime braille spinner.
  "ui.calm": "off",
  "ui.animations.enabled": true,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "braille",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 1.4,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#b6f23a",
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "spring",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 300,

  "appearance.density": "spacious"
}
